Five-input craft; independent rolls after2022-10-20; Mythic3% from2022-09-01. Server parity with observed display rates, equal failure-loss weights, quadratic XP progression and compatibility cap are explicit reconstruction. Original UI confirms failed loss range1..4; observed slot unlocks have separate levels.client-slots evidence.
Reuse W0 early batches, pools, special chance and cutoff.
Commands, respawn, reload, spawns, effects, movement/orbits, contacts, old poison, impacts, consume, deaths, wave transition.
u32 memory 53136, $902; exact archived Wasm bytes at file offset 2400435. Server rolls adopt same numeric table as explicit reconstruction.
Original $107 dispatches table143 to $3645: level<15 gives5; level>=15 gives6; >=30 gives7; >=45 gives8. XP curve and compatibility cap remain separately reconstructed.

Original $63 builds the cached gallery panels rendered by $1002. All 210 panels and 782 percentage labels are recorded; all 2160 candidate combinations preserve exact recovered calculations, original formatting and hiding/minimum-rarity conditions. Current four adopted probabilities use unrounded calculations. Historical server RNG, roll independence and allocation are not established.

ordering.poison: existing poison before new contact; first poison tick on following step; refresh per source, no same-source stacking
ordering.reload: per-slot shared group; begins when last particle leaves orbit; detached projectiles retain original owner and rarity
ordering.equip: validated life-scoped change replaces orbit particles, starts selected petal reload; detached projectiles/summons remain owned by firing life
ordering.effects: Rose heal delayed and consumes only on useful heal; Leaf passive per equipped slot, friendly mob contact consumes; Faster active while orbiting; Web areas nonstacking and expire

craft.failureLossMeaning: Independent uniform draw of destroyed inputs on a failed five-input attempt; failure returns 5 minus loss. Range corroborated by original UI, equal weights reconstructed.

levels.killXP: Each main-wave mob uses explicit catalog mob.xp, reconstructed 1/2/4/8/16/32 by rarity; summons/segments not independent rewards.
levels.capMeaning: Client level is u8; maximumLevel=255 is reconstructed safe server cap, not a verified historical progression limit. xpThresholds has maximumLevel+1 entries; final level256 threshold is progress-encoding sentinel only.
levels.provenance: XP curve reconstruction: retain Store quadratic progression proposal as a single catalog authority. No historical server XP curve or maximum level established. Threshold sensitivity uses candidateMultiplierRange. Slot unlocks at15/30/45 observed from original $107 -> table143 -> $3645 callback.

drops.note: Probabilities adopt exact recovered original-client drop calculations, checked against all 210 gallery panels. Only the existing four rules are implemented. Eligibility, allocation, exclusive selection and RNG remain reconstruction; the complete evidence table is not an exclusive distribution across petal kinds. No December 30 2022 allocation formula is adopted.
